text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq's Deputy Premier Tareq Aziz says in Amman that Iraq keen to improve its trade and political ties with Syria.
- Iraqi Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf meets Iranian Health Minister Ali Ridha Mirandi. Both express willingness to normalise bilateral ties in all aspects.
- Iraqi journalists are still holding talks in Damascus with Arab and Syrian journalists.
- Iraqi Trade Minister Mohammad Mehdi Saleh in Greece for trade talks with Greek officials.
- Editorial lashing out at chief U.N. arms inspector Rolf Ekeus accusing him of implementing a hostile U.S. policy against Iraq.
(The above except the editorial were carried by IRAQ)
- An Iraqi economic team ends visit to Syria where it held talks with Syrian officials on resuming trade between the two countries.
